message.content:
Step 1: Identify the German aircraft and aircraft engine manufacturer whose former engineers designed the Pirna 014. According to the source [Pirna 014], the Pirna 014 was designed by former Junkers engineers.
Step 2: Identify the city where Junkers was based. According to the source [Junkers], Junkers was a major German aircraft and aircraft engine manufacturer that had its fifty-plus year history in Dessau, Germany.
Therefore, the city is Dessau.

Final answer: Dessau
message.reasoning:
The question asks for the city where the German aircraft and aircraft engine manufacturer, whose former engineers designed the Pirna 014, was based.
From the source [Pirna 014]: "The Pirna 014 was an axial turbojet designed in East Germany (or the GDR) in the mid- to late 1950s by former Junkers engineers..."
So the manufacturer is Junkers.
From the source [Junkers]: "Junkers Flugzeug- und Motorenwerke AG (JFM, earlier JCO or JKO in World War I), more commonly Junkers, was a major German aircraft and aircraft engine manufacturer. It produced some of the world's most innovative and best-known airplanes over the course of its fifty-plus year history in Dessau, Germany."
So the city is Dessau.
The question asks "based in which city?".
The answer is Dessau.
